findings.title: Design record and a source comment wrongly claim per-instrument schemas $ref finding.schema.json
locations: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:629 — "lane-file wrapper and $ref's finding.schema.json for the findings array"
src/CLI/Rounds.jl:514-515 — "an instrument's / own schema $ref's it and adds its own fields"
src/CLI/Schema.jl:62 — startswith(ref, "#/") || throw(ArgumentError("only local $ref is supported: $ref"))
instruments/check-docs/schema.json:183 (and the equivalent line in the other 3 instrument schema.json files) — "$ref": "#/$defs/finding"
findings.description: ARCHITECTURE.md D11 and a Rounds.jl comment both assert that each instrument's schema.json '$ref's finding.schema.json' for its findings array. That mechanism cannot exist as described: Schema.jl's _deref only resolves a same-document fragment ('#/...') and throws ArgumentError on anything else, so a genuine cross-file $ref into schema/finding.schema.json is structurally impossible with this validator. What each of the 4 instrument schema.json files actually does is define its own separate, hand-typed $defs.finding (bug-hunt: $defs.hunt_finding) — a subset of schema/finding.schema.json's fields (missing the bank-assigned n/lane/seeded/id/carried_from/seed_class, which is correct) but otherwise a manual duplicate of the shared fields (severity/confidence/title/locations/description/type enums), not a reference to the one canonical copy. The core-shape re-check at Rounds.jl:519 narrows a banked finding onto the core schema's property set before validating, which catches an extra key but not a shared-field enum or pattern that has quietly drifted between the 5 hand-typed copies — exactly the single-source guarantee the design record and the comment both claim already exists.
findings.resolution_hint: Either extend Schema.jl's $ref resolution to support a cross-file pointer and change the 4 instrument schema.json files to actually reference it, or correct the ARCHITECTURE.md D11 prose and the Rounds.jl:514-515 comment to describe the real mechanism (a hand-synchronized duplicate subset, not a $ref).

findings.title: carried.schema.json alone declares JSON Schema draft-07 instead of 2020-12
locations: schema/round.schema.json:2 — "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema" (representative of the other 16 files, including the 4 instruments/*/schema.json)
findings.description: Every schema file in schema/ and instruments/*/schema.json declares $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema except carried.schema.json, which declares the older draft-07 identifier. Schema.jl's validator ignores $schema entirely, so this has no functional effect on validation, but it is a visible inconsistency in a corpus that ARCHITECTURE D11 advertises as 'one JSON Schema per artefact kind' — a uniform mechanism whose own metadata is not in fact uniform.
findings.resolution_hint: Change carried.schema.json's $schema value to the 2020-12 URL used by every other schema file.
